item.title: Stardew Valley Creator Says His New Game Is "More Of An Action RPG"

description.p: "It's for the people in Stardew Valley that go into the mines".Stardew Valley creator Eric Barone has been working on his new game The Haunted Chocolatier for over four years now, and during a recent chat with GQ, he's provided a quick reminder about what fans can expect from the gameplay.While the title is still what he calls a "town game" - similar to his existing farming and social sim, he sums up this new experience as "more of an action RPG". The main focus here will be all about "adventuring, finding equipment and getting more powerful", and you can also expect monsters and boss fights.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Nintendo States That It Has No Plans To Ditch Physical Media

description.p: "We know how much the fans like it".Bill van Zyll, vice president and general manager of Nintendo Latin America, has stated that the company currently has "no plans to ditch physical" media.This comes via an interview with Coelho no Japão on YouTube (thanks Nintendo Everything) at a time in which physical media is more at risk than ever. With Sony confirming its plan to cease production of PlayStation discs in early 2028 and Microsoft likely to follow suit, questions have no undoubtedly lingered as to whether Nintendo will also go all-digital. Thankfully, that doesn't seem to be the case... at least for now.Read the full article on nintendolife.com
